stale_rows.issue: Promises runtime/probe errors remain unverified, but per-schedule runtimeError values are accepted as task failures.

bugs.issue: Only top-level runtime_errors is checked. The actual cached-detail oracle records worker failures under schedules[id].runtimeError and returns UNDERREACH with exit 1. invoke accepts this report, causing evaluation to report failure instead of unverified.
bugs.evidence: Confirmed with invoke using the actual nested protocol shape.
bugs.fix: Check nonempty per-schedule runtimeError values before accepting a verdict.

bugs.issue: Final evaluation can remain absent indefinitely: load fetches a completed manifest before evaluation finishes; its subsequent refreshList observes active=null after evaluation finishes. Both polling conditions then become false, so detail never reloads.
bugs.evidence: The browser test explicitly reloads after backend completion, bypassing this transition.
bugs.fix: Refresh selected detail when activity ends, and verify automatic result display without page.reload().
